tools.name: effect_inspect
tools.description: 检查内置能力的精确版本、端口和参数

tools.name: effect_createDraft
tools.description: 生成新的受控声明式像素效果草稿；只能使用公开指令，不能含JS/WGSL或系统调用；需要validate compile preview evaluate后才可申请应用。args是从0计数的先前指令索引，不是直接数值。constant用value；parameter用parameter和component。u/v/time/frame/width/height/aspect/input/constant/parameter无args；sin/cos/abs/sqrt/floor一个args；add/subtract/multiply/divide/min/max两个args；mix/clamp/smoothstep/noise三个args。mix(a,b,t)=a+(b-a)*t；clamp(x,min,max)；smoothstep(edge0,edge1,x)。RGBA输出和color默认值使用0..1，color需四个分量。noise需整数seed参数。示例instructions=[{op:"u"},{op:"constant",value:6},{op:"multiply",args:[0,1]},{op:"sin",args:[2]}]。

tools.name: effect_updateDraft
tools.description: 更新草稿并使旧预览和检查失效

tools.name: effect_validate
tools.description: 验证草稿的源定义、端口、绑定与资源限制

tools.name: effect_compile
tools.description: 编译已验证草稿，按源内容哈希缓存

tools.name: effect_preview
tools.description: 真实渲染草稿192×108预览，返回像素统计；隐私许可且有识图能力时可发送图片。统计不代表满足视觉目标。

tools.name: effect_evaluate
tools.description: 记录真实预览的检查结论；没有视觉证据时必须标明限制，应用后仍由Observer检查

tools.name: effect_getDiagnostics
tools.description: 读取草稿状态及错误，不返回源代码执行权限

tools.name: effect_discardDraft
tools.description: 丢弃临时草稿，工程不变

tools.name: effect_saveReusable
tools.description: 仅发起保存建议。正式效果库只能由用户在效果浏览器检查并显式保存；本工具不会静默安装。

tools.name: effect_createDraft
tools.description: 生成新的受控声明式像素效果草稿；只能使用公开指令，不能含JS/WGSL或系统调用；需要validate compile preview evaluate后才可申请应用。args是从0计数的先前指令索引，不是直接数值。constant用value；parameter用parameter和component。u/v/time/frame/width/height/aspect/input/constant/parameter无args；sin/cos/abs/sqrt/floor一个args；add/subtract/multiply/divide/min/max两个args；mix/clamp/smoothstep/noise三个args。mix(a,b,t)=a+(b-a)*t；clamp(x,min,max)；smoothstep(edge0,edge1,x)。RGBA输出和color默认值使用0..1，color需四个分量。noise需整数seed参数。示例instructions=[{op:"u"},{op:"constant",value:6},{op:"multiply",args:[0,1]},{op:"sin",args:[2]}]。

tools.name: submitPlan
tools.description: Submit a complete editing plan for validation. Writes may only be requested inside this plan.

tools.name: compileGraph
tools.description: 调用共享合成图服务：compileGraph

tools.name: inspectProject
tools.description: Read project metadata and composition index; no filesystem or asset bodies.

tools.name: inspectComposition
tools.description: Read composition dimensions, timing and bounded layer summary.

tools.name: listLayers
tools.description: List a page of layers with stable IDs.

tools.name: inspectLayer
tools.description: Read selected layer properties, keyframes, graph summary and bounds.

tools.name: inspectSelection
tools.description: Read the current selection and active composition.

tools.name: inspectProperty
tools.description: Read property value and animated state by stable ID.

tools.name: inspectKeyframes
tools.description: Read a page of actual persisted keyframes.

tools.name: inspectEffects
tools.description: Read effect node identities and actual parameters.

tools.name: inspectGraph
tools.description: Read graph nodes, edges and parameters without mutation.

tools.name: inspectAssets
tools.description: Read imported asset metadata only. Never disk paths or embedded data.

tools.name: getCurrentTime
tools.description: Read current timeline time in seconds.

tools.name: getCanvasInfo
tools.description: Read composition canvas size and active camera.

tools.name: effect_list
tools.description: 列出统一内置能力。优先复用，禁止为已支持的基础模糊或径向渐变造新程序。

tools.name: effect_search
tools.description: 先搜索内置能力，再考虑组合节点，最后才创建程序化草稿。

tools.name: effect_inspect
tools.description: 检查内置能力的精确版本、端口和参数

tools.name: effect_createDraft
tools.description: 生成新的受控声明式像素效果草稿；只能使用公开指令，不能含JS/WGSL或系统调用；需要validate compile preview evaluate后才可申请应用。args是从0计数的先前指令索引，不是直接数值。constant用value；parameter用parameter和component。u/v/time/frame/width/height/aspect/input/constant/parameter无args；sin/cos/abs/sqrt/floor一个args；add/subtract/multiply/divide/min/max两个args；mix/clamp/smoothstep/noise三个args。mix(a,b,t)=a+(b-a)*t；clamp(x,min,max)；smoothstep(edge0,edge1,x)。RGBA输出和color默认值使用0..1，color需四个分量。noise需整数seed参数。示例instructions=[{op:"u"},{op:"constant",value:6},{op:"multiply",args:[0,1]},{op:"sin",args:[2]}]。

tools.name: effect_updateDraft
tools.description: 更新草稿并使旧预览和检查失效

tools.name: effect_validate
tools.description: 验证草稿的源定义、端口、绑定与资源限制

tools.name: effect_compile
tools.description: 编译已验证草稿，按源内容哈希缓存

tools.name: effect_preview
tools.description: 真实渲染草稿192×108预览，返回像素统计；隐私许可且有识图能力时可发送图片。统计不代表满足视觉目标。

tools.name: effect_evaluate
tools.description: 记录真实预览的检查结论；没有视觉证据时必须标明限制，应用后仍由Observer检查

tools.name: effect_getDiagnostics
tools.description: 读取草稿状态及错误，不返回源代码执行权限

tools.name: effect_discardDraft
tools.description: 丢弃临时草稿，工程不变

tools.name: effect_saveReusable
tools.description: 仅发起保存建议。正式效果库只能由用户在效果浏览器检查并显式保存；本工具不会静默安装。

tools.name: listAgentPresets
tools.description: 读取用户保存的实际动画属性预设

tools.name: renderFrame
tools.description: 真实合成预览，最长边720像素；不会含选择框

tools.name: analyzeLayout
tools.description: 只返回专业 Proposal，由 Agent 决定是否转换成共享命令

tools.name: discoverCapabilities
tools.description: 查询真实命令、Fill/Generator/Effect/Node、可复用程序包及已接入服务。modify-existing > reuse > compose > generate > forge。
